notes: Black Friday offer statics from 5 user-supplied refs (Nov 19). Current offer 40% off + free case & bag + free shipping + 120-day guarantee. Invented scarcity/overstock stories from the refs are replaced with honest lines.

concepts.headline: 40% OFF. Black Friday Sale.
concepts.prompt: Compared with the second attached image: keep EVERYTHING identical (layout, every word of text, fonts, colors, background, lighting, the DentalPULSE Pod, the denture, sizes and positions); the ONLY change: remove the black travel bag and the dark dental case (and its small blue brush) completely, and fill the space they leave with the same surface and background so nothing looks missing. Add nothing else. Do not show any bag, pouch, case or box other than what remains in the second image.
